message.reasoning: We have a customer complaining that a newly created record is not appearing in search. The policy excerpts (DOC-035) explain that this is due to indexing delay, resolves within a couple minutes, and if after several minutes still not appears, report. So answer: explain indexing delay, wait a couple minutes, if still not appears after several minutes, report. Provide short answer. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"When a record is created, the browse view shows it immediately, but the search index is updated a short time later. This brief indexing delay can cause a newly‑created record to not appear in search for a few minutes. In most cases it resolves on its own within a couple of minutes with no action needed. If the record still isn’t showing up after several minutes, please let us know so we can investigate further."}
